title: Proslav Land, so Dear to Every Worker
author: Clev
description: Lyrics were mostly written by Clev to a melody by Isaak Dunayevsky ("Wide is my Motherland", 1936).
content:
Proslav land, so dear to every worker,
Peace and progress build their hopes on thee,
There's no other land the whole world over,
Where man walks the earth so proud and free!

There's no other land the whole world over,
Where man walks the earth so proud and free!

From Newmerth to our farthest borders,
We have countless towns both great and small,
And the name we give each worker - comrade,
Is to us the proudest name of all!
Everywhere our life is wide and joyous,
Like our rivers flowing in the spring,
To the young the road to life lies open,
To the old great happiness we bring!

Proslav land, so dear to every worker,
Peace and progress build their hopes on thee,
There's no other land the whole world over,
Where man walks the earth so proud and free!
There's no other land the whole world over,
Where man walks the earth so proud and free!

At our table, no one is excluded,
Each and all is working to inspire,
And with all our efforts we've provided,
Any needs all human hearts require.
Our words... forever in the light,
And our people always know it best:
That a person always has the right
To study, work and rest!

**Proslav land, so dear to every worker,
Peace and progress build their hopes on thee,
There's no other land the whole world over,
Where man walks the earth so proud and free!
There's no other land the whole world over,
Where man walks the earth so proud and free!**

title: On a late, peaceful Sunday night...
author: Nina
description: Written by Nina for a poetry contest in Proslavia.
content:
On a late, peaceful Sunday night,
We were holding each other so near,
And by the onset of moonlight,
You are no longer here.

I don't sleep until morning dawns,
Staying up late I think of you,
Knowing to you I'd never do wrong,
That I'll always be true to you...

Will you always remember me,
If we don't meet again too soon?
Will you think day and night, every hour that passes, will you think of me..?

Because you don't abandon my thoughts,
I remember and don't let your memory fade,
Yes, you are the only one I need and got,
With you I feel no hate.

Thinking of when I first met you,
So far back and so far away,
I knew that my life wasn't yet through,
There was no better day.

Whether you're here or not with me,
My life's turned itself upside down,
I have never yet felt as free,
As when you're around.

Will you always remember me,
If we don't meet again too soon?
Will you think day and night, every hour that passes, will you think of me..?

Because you don't abandon my thoughts,
I remember and don't let your memory fade,
Yes, you are the only one I need and got,
With you I feel no hate.

On a late, peaceful Sunday night,
We were holding each other so near,
And by the onset of moonlight,
You are no longer here.

I don't sleep until morning dawns,
Staying up late I think of you,
Knowing to you I'd never do wrong,
That I'll always be true to you...

title: From desert to mountain, from river to sea!
author: Luna
description: Written by Luna in 2025 for a Proslav poetry contest
content:
In a land far away, right now and back then,
Where resolute millions,
Fight to be free,
The Palestinian sun will shine again,
From desert to mountain,
From river to sea.

No settler, no murder, no cowardly thief,
Stuck to their chiefdom,
In all certainty,
Know the inspired native's strong belief,
In peace and in freedom,
In true liberty.

For 80 years, the struggle went on,
Martyr for martyr,
Man for man,
They never left each other alone,
Fighter for fighter,
The fray began.

No 'Merican soldiers, no murders of kids,
No British soldiers,
No orange men,
Could cross Palestine without a miss,
Its Judaean boulders,
Or Gaza's defense.

The world may be watching or cover its eyes,
At war and at poverty,
At genocide,
But the struggle of Palestine never dies!
For freedom and liberty,
Which shall abide.

In a land far away, right now and back then,
Where resolute millions,
Fight to be free,
The Palestinian sun will shine again,
From desert to mountain,
From river to sea.

title: We Sing This Song for You, Proslavia
author: Clev
description: The lyrics were written in 2026 by Clev to a melody by an unknown DPR Korean composer
content:
Your mighty seas, your rivers flow into our hearts,
Your tender sun, its mild embrace, warm us when we're cold,
There's no other place out there, to which I would depart,
We're here for you, day and night, young and old!

Every spring, you start to bloom, dear Proslavia!
Every summer, your bright red sun brings warmth along for hours!
In autumns, in winter you shelter us!
Through the years, we're with you, Proslavia!

Only right here, we find the place, that we call our home,
Only right here, we find true love, peace and happiness,
All of our hopes, all our desires, all of our dreams that grow,
Only right here, do all of them take place!

We defend you, we stand guard, dear Proslavia!
Not a single soul on earth can take you away from us!
We stand for your ideals, for your just cause!
Through the years, we're with you, Proslavia!

Recalling the past, we think of the many years we'll have with you,
We have grown up, we've gotten old, in our native land,
Even when all has gone, you stay through the foggiest dew,
Forever we follow your call and command!

I desire no other place, dear Proslavia!
We are brothers and sisters here, we're one family!
And here we shall thrive, and here we are free!
We sing this song for you, Proslavia!

title: White Snow
author: Clev
description: Lyrics were written by Clev in 2025 to a melody by a Soviet Belarusian composer
content:
White snow, white snow, white snow, let it lay,
White snow, white snow, let it whiten the day,
But just why do you want me to go,
In the snow, in the cold, stinging snow?
And outside there's no people, no cars,
There's not been any for many hours,
In the snow, in the cold, stinging snow,
Are you sure that you want me to go?
And outside there's no people, no cars,
No people, no cars.

White snow, white snow, and its cold, frosty road,
White snow, white snow, and its white, shiny glow,
After you, I carefully follow,
As we walk through the infinite snow,
As we slide over slippery paths,
As we slide over slippery paths,
As we walk through the infinite snow,
After you, I carefully follow,
As we slide over slippery paths,
Over slippery paths.

White snow, white snow, falling from white clouds,
White snow, white snow, that's what I dream about,
And with you, I walk through high and low,
It's just me and you and the snow,
There's no gazing from windows around,
It's just you and just me in this town,
It's just me and you and the snow,
And with you, I walk through high and low,
It's just you and just me in this town,
You and me in this town...
